resume: Opioid overdoses do not only kill drug abusers: people taking drugs for pain can also slip over the edge, and one condition treated with pain relief drugs is cancer. Cancer happens when the body produces too many abnormal cells that the immune system cannot stop, and when it overwhelms vital organs it ends life, with statistically a high chance that people die this way.
